articles.title: Planes Stop Flying All Over the U.S.
articles.summary: The FAA told all planes in the U.S. to stay on the ground on Friday after a communications problem; officials said it was not an attack and everyone was safe.

articles.title: Starship Flies to Orbit, but Its Booster Is Lost
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit on Friday, but its booster broke down and fell into the sea instead of being caught at the launch pad.

articles.title: Alaska Picks Its Youngest Governor Ever
articles.summary: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, won Alaska's governor race and will be the state's youngest governor ever.
